outcome: Copilot through the Claude Code plugin: chat, autocomplete and agents in the web app, proposals with review and provenance, AI-usage annex
proof: bridge test per supported Claude Code version; validator and injection fixtures; recall@10 >= 0.8; annex test

contracts.northstar: bridge test per supported Claude Code version
contracts.negative: A bridge request without the token is refused and logged, and a version not on the supported list fails the step.
contracts.source: #102 AC2, AC3, AC4, AC5; operator answer 45

contracts.northstar: Quotes, pages, numbers and cite keys are checked by code, never by a model
contracts.negative: Every bad case of the adversarial set (cite key outside the library, number not backed by a passage, quote not verbatim, printed page neither derived nor set) is rejected with its expected rule id.
No injection fixture text from a PDF, a transcript or a search result is submitted as a prompt or causes a state change other than a proposal, a marked wishlist entry or a pending capture.
A ranking with the gold sources removed from the top ten scores below 0.8 and the measurement reports it red.

contracts.northstar: every change they make is a reviewable proposal
contracts.negative: Accept-all on proposals whose resulting document has a red trace check applies nothing, and a deletion over more than three blocks, a rawLatex change and an externally influenced deletion stay pending for a single review.

contracts.northstar: the author can export a disclosure annex
contracts.negative: Human edits, pending and stale proposals and drafts the validator rejected get no annex entry, and an export without the annex request holds no model id or agent id.
A job that reaches the usage threshold pauses, and after a server restart it resumes at the next step without running any step twice or duplicating a proposal.

contracts.northstar: autocomplete and agents beside the editor suggest the next sentence
contracts.negative: Typing during the pause cancels the pending request and no ghost text appears.

contracts.northstar: bridge test per supported Claude Code version
contracts.operator: Before each release the lead session runs scripts/bridge/run-bridge-test-real.sh for the current and the previous stable Claude Code release under the operator's Claude Code login (docs/autonomy/charter.md section 3, real runs) and pastes the bridge-test V real lines into the release ticket; the release panel (.claude/workflows/ar-release.js) checks them. Whether that login reaches a nested claude process in the cloud VM is Nicht verifiziert; without the lines the panel holds the release.
contracts.source: #102 AC3, AC17; operator answer 45; operator decisions 4 and 8 of 2026-10-20
